title: Macedonian — ISO 9:1995
authority: ISO 9:1995 (Information and documentation — Transliteration of Cyrillic characters into Latin characters)
description: Language-independent one-to-one transliteration applied to Macedonian: Ѓ→ǵ, Ѕ→ẑ, Ј→ǰ, Љ→l̂, Њ→n̂, Ќ→ḱ, Џ→d̂, with č/š/ž. Reversible; rarely used outside documentation.
notes: l̂, n̂, d̂ and capital J̌ have no precomposed code points: they are written as base letter + U+0302 COMBINING CIRCUMFLEX (U+030C CARON for J̌). Lower-case ǰ is precomposed U+01F0.
ISO 9:1968 (and the Macedonian Academy 1970 / BGN/PCGN 2013 system) uses ǵ ž dz j lj nj ḱ č dž š instead; see mk_bgn_pcgn.
